Grouping the functions of a package

Source: R/package_tools.R
group_functions.Rd

group_functions() lists the exported functions of a package that match a pattern, leaves out the defunct and deprecated functions, and groups the rest by the prefix before the first underscore.

Usage

group_functions(pattern = "", package = "manynet")

Arguments

pattern

A regular expression that the function names must match. By default "", which matches all of them.

package

The name of an installed package. By default "manynet".

Value

A named list of character vectors of function names, with one element for each prefix.

Examples

group_functions("^find", package = "manypkgs")
#> $find
#> [1] "find_installed_pkg_sizes" "find_nonascii"           
#> [3] "find_required_r"          "find_transitive_minR"    
#> [5] "find_undocumented_values"
#>
